judge.rationale: The candidate is an incomplete mid-flight implementation, as evidenced by the unchecked facets in its committed `.lore/dod.md` file. Function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` definitions are compiled only once at `register` time rather than resolved per `execute` call and cached in a `WeakMap`, violating the dynamic schema requirement. It also fails to emit a warning log on validation failure, omits the required one-line JSDoc on `execute`, and commits the internal `.lore/dod.md` artifact. Furthermore, most required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing, and none of the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, or `example/weather-tool.ts` were performed.
